name: Chris Johnson
original_name: クリス ジョンソン
source:
[spoiler]The Johnson family is a self-defense group of "Fire and Water People" located in Australia. They have a track record of defeating the Royal Psychic Society (an organization that searches for scientific explanations of the supernatural) in the past. 

It is rare for those on the "Spirit" side, like the Johnson family, to openly form a group and resist. They are currently in a ceasefire with the Royal Psychic Society.[/spoiler]

[Translated and edited from [url=https://watanabekobi.fanbox.cc/posts/4548887]渡辺　僚一 (Watanabe Ryōichi) on pixivFANBOX[/url]]
